title.en: A public proof redraws one boundary of quantum advantage
title.zh: 一份公开证明，划清量子优势的一道边界

summary.en: An AI-assisted proof, human exposition and formal verification records sharpen a long-standing question about random inputs and quantum queries.
summary.zh: AI 辅助证明、人类阐释与形式验证记录，共同澄清随机输入与量子查询的一项长期问题。

title.en: New York funds15 routes toward a longer-lasting energy store
title.zh: 纽约资助15个项目，探索更长时储能

summary.en: Nearly$13million in development and demonstration awards spans iron-sodium, compressed-air heat storage and improved batteries; real-world performance remains ahead.
summary.zh: 近1300万美元研发与示范资助涵盖铁钠、压缩空气储热及电池改进；真实运行表现仍待验证。
